title: Fix SMPTE 29.97 Drop-Frame Minute Boundary Calculation
taskDescription: At minute boundaries not divisible by 10 in 29.97 fps drop-frame timecode, frames 00 and 01 must be dropped from the display representation. Fix the frame-to-timecode conversion function so it does not drift over 1-hour timelines.
expectedBehavior: Frame index 107892 translates to 01:00:00;00 exactly. No floating point rounding drift.
architecturalConstraints: Zero OS branching in timecode math
Must not alter non-drop-frame calculation semantics
acceptanceCriteria: Drop-frame minute boundaries pass 100% of unit tests
1-hour timeline frame count matches SMPTE specification exactly
